deactivated_patient_not_edited_disjointn.description: An HCP attempts to edit a deactivated patient account. A policy that broadly permits HCPs to edit patients would violate the deactivated-patient safety rule.

patient_view_own_access_log_active_sessi.description: A patient attempts to view another patient's access log even though their session is active; the own-log equality should prevent this floor from requiring permission.
A patient attempts to view their own access log using an inactive session; the active-session condition should prevent this floor from requiring permission after authorization is disabled.

personal_representative_view_represented.description: A personal representative attempts to view a represented patient's access log with an inactive representative relationship; this floor should not require permission for that case.

access_log_active_session_own_or_represe.description: A patient attempts to view another patient's access log without an active personal-representative relationship.
A personal representative attempts to view a represented patient's access log after their session has become inactive.

medical_record_active_session_own_or_rep.description: A patient attempts to view another patient's medical record using an active session but without an active representative relationship for that patient.
A personal representative attempts to view a represented patient's medical record after their representative relationship has become inactive.
A patient attempts to view their own medical record through an inactive session after authorization should be disabled.
